canonical_data: a graph database of code symbols, relationships, embeddings, and cross-repository contract registries
strengths: Ships a real graph database with ad-hoc Cypher, hybrid keyword and vector search, and program-dependence queries
Cross-repository groups join microservice graphs through a provider and consumer contract registry for blast-radius analysis
Documents its own hosted-deploy weakness plainly, stating the bearer token is the only control on that deployment
weaknesses: The PolyForm Noncommercial license bars commercial use, and GitHub reports the repository as having no recognised license
The roadmap lists incremental indexing as unfinished while the command reference documents it as working
Twenty-two release candidates of a single patch version, three within about seventy minutes, indicate an unsettled release process
why_it_matters: The most capable open code-graph engine for agents, and a clear case where a restrictive license and a vendor-run edition shape how a record must be classified.
